description: This script manages DHCP client operations and WAN interface updates, including starting/stopping DHCP, updating WAN IP and subnet, and handling redirection flags.

methods.name: do_stop_dhcp
methods.description: Stops the DHCP client by killing its process and removing the PID file.

methods.name: do_start_dhcp
methods.description: Starts the DHCP client if not already running.

methods.name: do_wan_update
methods.description: Updates WAN IP and subnet, and manages redirection flags.
